school_info.name_ar: مدرسة الملك حسين بن طلال الثانوية الشاملة للبنين
school_info.name_en: King Hussein Bin Talal Comprehensive Secondary School for Boys
school_info.system_type: Production-Ready Arabic-First RTL School Attendance Management SaaS

design_archetype: Regal Sovereign Academy — High-Density Civic & Educational Precision
direction_rule: RTL First (dir='rtl' on root <html>/<div>). All navigation, sidebars, forms, breadcrumbs, and grids flow Right-To-Left. English toggle flips layout cleanly via dir='ltr'.

typography.font_family_ar: Cairo, Tajawal, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif

arabic_rules.letter_spacing: CRITICAL: Set tracking-normal or letter-spacing: 0 on Arabic text. NEVER use tracking-tight or tracking-wide on Arabic scripts because it breaks cursive character ligatures.
arabic_rules.min_body_size: 15px to 16px (text-base) for optimal Arabic glyph legibility.

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl (cards & modals), rounded-lg (buttons & inputs), rounded-full (chips & badges)

sidebar.position: Right-aligned in RTL (fixed right-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 or w-72)
sidebar.style: bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between z-40
sidebar.item_active: bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 font-bold border-r-4 border-emerald-500 ps-4 pe-3 py-3 rounded-l-lg
sidebar.item_inactive: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-800/60 ps-4 pe-3 py-3 transition-colors

header.style: sticky top-0 z-30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
header.elements: Breadcrumbs (RTL chevron), Global Search Bar (Ctrl+K), Language Toggle (AR/EN), Theme Switcher (Light/Dark/System), Notifications Bell, User Profile Drawer

kpi_card.style: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-5 relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-sm
kpi_card.elements: Top icon container with soft status tint, primary numeric metric in bold 2xl, Arabic label in muted text, percentage change pill with emerald/rose arrow

fast_attendance_screen.header_actions: Class Selector + Date Picker + Search Student input + 'Mark All Present' (تحديد الكل حاضر) button
fast_attendance_screen.student_row_card: Flex row or responsive grid card showing student photo avatar, roll number, full name, previous attendance status badge, and 5 status buttons (حاضر, غائب, متأخر, بعذر, خروج مبكر)
fast_attendance_screen.sticky_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border flex items-center justify-between z-20
fast_attendance_screen.submit_lock_btn: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2

data_tables.header_row: bg-muted/50 border-b border-border text-start text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase py-3.5 px-4
data_tables.data_row: border-b border-border/60 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors py-3 px-4 text-sm text-foreground
data_tables.empty_state: py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, badges, table rows, tab triggers, modal triggers MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format. E.g., data-testid='mark-all-present-button', data-testid='student-status-present-101', data-testid='attendance-submit-lock-btn'.
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure text color contrast passes WCAG AA / APCA standards in both light and dark themes.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_contrast: Set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply dir='rtl' on root wrapper, with lang='ar' by default.
Include an intuitive language switch button (العربية / English) that toggles document direction between RTL and LTR smoothly.
Never apply letter-spacing/tracking utilities to Arabic text.
Ensure Cairo or Tajawal Google font is imported in index.html or index.css.
Implement Sonner toast notification system for attendance lock, correction workflows, and alerts.
Add data-testid attributes to every clickable or form element.
Use high-density layout for analytics dashboard and mobile-optimized 1-tap buttons for fast attendance taking screen.
